helpPage.title: Hypernet Explorer Help
helpPage.heading: Hypernet Explorer Help
helpPage.intro: Everything this browser can do, and the key that does it.
helpPage.navBody: Type an address in the Address bar and press Enter. An address with no dot in it is searched for instead. A page that is not on this gateway shows the gateway's own 404 notice with the nearest matching addresses under it.
keys: Ctrl+L - go to the Address bar
Ctrl+D - add the page to Favorites
helpPage.favBody: Favorites are kept in the terminal's registry, so they survive the machine being switched off and travel with the save.
helpPage.offlineBody: The gateway holds a local copy of every document in the Hypernet Zone, so pages open with the line down. Only addresses outside the Zone need the line, and there are none.

tip.title: Tip of the Day
tips: An address with no dot in it is treated as a search. Type a phrase and press Enter.
Middle of a long page? Ctrl+F finds a word without scrolling for it.
The Links bar takes as many Favorites as you care to pin to it.
Ctrl+T opens a tab. Each tab keeps its own Back and Forward.
Source (Ctrl+U) shows a page exactly as the gateway sent it.
The Hypernet Directory on the home page lists every site the gateway holds.
A page that will not display shows the nearest addresses it could have meant.
Zoom lives on the status bar. Click the percentage to cycle it.
Pop-ups are blocked by default. Tools, Pop-up Blocker changes that, at your own risk.
Anything saved off a page lands in C:\Documents and shows up in My Computer.
